current_status.stage: Approved (US, Canada, EU, Taiwan, Israel, UK) 42mg/6-month; FDA-approved Aug 2025 as Camcevi ETM 21mg/3-month; EU 21mg/3-month strength has a positive CHMP opinion (Mar 2026) with European Commission decision expected Q2 2026 — final EC approval not independently confirmed as of this research.
current_status.dosing_target: 3-month (21mg) or 6-month (42mg) subcutaneous, ready-to-use pre-filled syringe (no on-site mixing)
current_status.partner: Accord BioPharma / Accord Healthcare (Intas Pharmaceuticals' specialty division) — exclusive US and EU commercialization
current_status.data_point: Phase 3 data supporting the 21mg/3-month FDA approval showed 97.9% of 144 enrolled advanced prostate cancer patients achieving the primary efficacy endpoint

finding_history.summary: Foresee announced FDA Orange Book listing of new US patent (No. 11,717,555 B2, 'Pharmaceutical Compositions Having a Selected Release Duration', issued 2023-08-08), extending Camcevi's US patent protection to January 1, 2039 and bringing total Orange Book-listed Camcevi patents from three to four. The patent also covers other LHRH products in Foresee's SIF pipeline. [Technology-family note: the seed hint's 'ProGel' name could not be substantiated — 'ProGel' is an unrelated Australian oral-delivery company. Foresee's verified platform is 'Stabilized Injectable Formulation (SIF)' (Camcevi's variant: SIF-ADAGIO). Per the FDA label, Camcevi is formulated in N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) + poly(d,l-lactide), which precipitates into a solid depot after subcutaneous injection — an in-situ solvent-exchange mechanism, the same class as Eligard/Atrigel — so 'in_situ_forming_depot' was chosen over 'plga_microsphere'.]

Foresee publicly disclosed four proprietary SIF long-acting-injectable delivery sub-platforms: SIF-ADAGIO (Camcevi's mechanism, also being applied to FP-014, a subcutaneous triptorelin LAI with 3- and 6-month dosing), SIF-LEGATO (lipid-based, high drug-loading, early neurology use), SIF-DUO (solution-based, early psychiatry LAI programs), and SIF-MEZZO (still in development/optimization).

Foresee announced FDA approval (approval date 2025-08-25) of CAMCEVI ETM — a ready-to-use 21mg, 3-month leuprolide mesylate LAI for advanced prostate cancer — exclusively licensed to Accord BioPharma for US commercialization pending a CMS J-code.

CHMP issued a positive opinion recommending an extension of Camcevi's EU marketing authorization to add a 21mg, 3-month ready-to-use strength for advanced prostate cancer, complementing the already-launched (2025) 42mg/6-month strength. Final European Commission decision was expected in Q2 2026; EC approval itself was not independently confirmed by this research as of Sept 2026.
